One of the premier institutions of higher learning, Barbhag College has been rendering its services mainly to the students of greater Barbhag for the last 55 years. Despite all obvious constraints that characterise any institution located in an interior rural area, the college has produced. thousands of graduates till date. It is the presence of this institution which has made greater Barbhag one of the educationally developed rural areas in the state.
The challenges in higher education coming with the increasing learning needs for students in a globalised world call for rapid augmentation of human and other resources in Highter Educational Institutions. As a college located in a rural area, we have always faced resource crunch. But, notwithstanding our limitations, we have been able to march ahead with other institutions of higher education in the state. We have spared no effort to provide the best possible facilities and support services to our students. The newly constructed Central Library of the college is one of the most well-equipped and modern college libraries in Assam. The glory of an institution depends mainly on the academic achievements of the students. I hope that our students will make the best use of all the available facilities and put up their best efforts towards academic excellence.
Principal's Desk
Mr. Ajit Kumar Sarma
Principal i/c
About The College
Considering the much-awaited and long-felt need for an institution imparting quality education at the higher level of study with an eye on the character building of the younger generation in the Barbhag area of Nalbari District, Barbhag College was established in the year 1964.The birth of this institution was the result of the toil and sacrifices of a few spirited and progressive individuals who worked day and night for years to turn this long cherished dream into reality. Since its inception,the institution has been striving hard to make the rural folk of Barbhag truly educated.
